title: Chat
description: Chat - the Local room, open and closed groups, and 1:1 conversations over XPRS.
summary: A chat for XPRS stations. The Local room is everyone in radio range; open groups are named channels; closed groups are members-only; a 1:1 is a conversation with a station by callsign, sealed when both keys are known. The core carries every message over whatever bearer it has - Bluetooth, the local network, Reticulum, LoRa - and this wapp only says what it wants said. Each conversation is its own database on this device.
